prompt_base: Concept art of a single old refrigerator standing alone in nature, as a prop for a cozy low-poly 3D island game for children, cute and friendly, nothing dirty, rusty, broken or scary. Match exactly the art style of the reference screenshots: simple chunky rounded shapes, toy-like proportions, flat toon shading with three tones, soft saturated colors, no outlines, no realistic texture. A retro rounded fridge with a big handle, closed doors, no brand, no logo, no text. Nature has taken it gently: moss, small plants and flowers growing on it. Show only the fridge, full object in frame, three-quarter view from slightly above, on a plain light grey background, no ground, no shadow, no characters.
